phases.name: Phase 1: Recovery foundation
phases.focus: Promote gradual activation with emphasis on diaphragmatic breathing, pelvic floor engagement, and light total-body movements avoiding high impact and core loading.

phases.name: Phase 2: Paths to movement
phases.focus: Increase movement variety with gentle strength cues, maintain pelvic floor awareness, and introduce light resistance using bodyweight and equipment-free options.

phases.name: Phase 3: Build confidence
phases.focus: Reintroduce progressively challenging movements at low to moderate intensity while protecting abdominal region and practicing self-checks for diastasis and core endurance.

non_negotiables: OB cleared her for light activity only
walking, no abs, no heavy lifting until her six-week check

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week postpartum return program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary:
    name "Postpartum return to gentle movement with diaphragmatic breathing, pelvic floor engagement, and progressive, low-load workouts on a mat"
PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Recovery foundation" (weeks 4):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY movement training 25m "<Phase 1 Day 1 - diaphragmatic breathing and gentle activation>":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 1x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_floor_engagement 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          leg_circles 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge_zero_spine 2x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing_cooldown 3m
      DAY breath/core training 15m "<Phase 1 Day 2 - breath work and light core awareness>":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 2m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x6 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_floor_activation_walk 2x30s rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_relaxation 3m
      DAY mobilize/recover 20m "<Phase 1 Day 3 - mobility and gentle joints>":
        warmup:
          ankle_rolls 1m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_circles 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          shoulder_pass_through_pvc 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          thoracic_section_roll_down 2x6 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
      DAY progression 20m "<Phase 1 Day 4 - light movement practice>":
        warmup:
          march_in_place 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_squat_assist 2x10 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          wall_push_up_knee_from_floor 2x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          hip_bridge with miniature isometric hold 2x6  hold 2s rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing_and_relaxation 3m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Paths to movement" (weeks 4):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY movement training 28m "<Phase 2 Day 1 - introduce gentle resistance options>":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 1m
          arm_circles 1m
          hip_hinge_mobilize 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_squat 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          incline_push_ups_knee 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          superman_prep 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge_band_stabilize 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m each side
    WEEK 6:
      DAY breath/core training 18m "<Phase 2 Day 2 - core awareness with light loading>":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          side_plank_knee_down 3x20s each side rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_floor_activation_walk 3x40s rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated_forward_fold 2m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY mobilize/recover 22m "<Phase 2 Day 3 - mobility and active recovery>":
        warmup:
          ankle_to_knee_clock 2m
        main straight_sets:
          thoracic_thread_the-needle 3x6 each side rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_opening_sequence 3x8 each side rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child's_pose_with_breath 4m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY progression 24m "<Phase 2 Day 4 - progressive movement with control>":
        warmup:
          marching_heel_to_toe 3m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          push_up_knee_from_floor 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row_from_floor 3x10 each side (substitute with towel-row under mat) rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist_gentle 2m
  PHASE "Phase 3: Build confidence" (weeks 4):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY movement training 26m "<Phase 3 Day 1 - reintroduce movements with low-mod intensity>":
        warmup:
          walk_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat_assist 3x12 each leg rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          incline_push_ups 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust_floor 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_cobra 3m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY breath/core training 20m "<Phase 3 Day 2 - core endurance check and breathing>":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 4m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          planks_modified_on_knees 3x20s rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          side_plank_knee_down 3x20s each side rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          relaxed_breathing 3m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY mobilize/recover 24m "<Phase 3 Day 3 - mobility, stability, and confidence>":
        warmup:
          neck_shoulder_relax 2m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_abduction_stability 3x12 each side rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge_with_single_leg_control 3x10 each side rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 each side rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose_with_breath 4m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY progression 28m "<Phase 3 Day 4 - consolidate gains and plan next steps>":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place(very light) 3m
        main straight_sets:
          step_up_on_stable_support 3x12 each side rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press_floor 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row_floor 3x12 each side rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_walks_without_weight 2x30s rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_relaxation 5m

END_PLAN
